description.value: Café 106 is a specialty coffee shop tucked into a commercial unit on Royal Oak Avenue in Burnaby, emphasizing quality beans and made-to-order preparation. The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a relaxed stop for cyclists passing through the Royal Oak corridor. Online ordering is available for those wanting a quick grab-and-go.

address.value: 106-6588 Royal Oak Ave, Burnaby, BC V5H 2E6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 11m; stands (5 spaces) at 21m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thecafe106.weebly.com is live and consistent with OSM tags: same address unit, same hours pattern, indoor and outdoor seating confirmed by both OSM (indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=yes) and the website. The website adds a phone number (+1 604 438 1220) absent from OSM, and clarifies the city as Burnaby rather than Vancouver. An 'ONLINE ORDER' link on the menu page supports takeout. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business is in Burnaby per the website and street address.
OSM has no phone number; +1 604 438 1220 sourced from website only.
Website has apparent typos in Saturday and Sunday hours display (shows 'pm' instead of 'am' for opening times); website content quality is low overall but business appears real and active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café with a live website, recent OSM check date (2025-11-09), and confirmed address. Useful coffee stop for touring cyclists on the Royal Oak corridor.

wow_evidence: outdoor seating, making it a relaxed stop for cyclists passing through the Royal Oak corridor
